title: ONLINE in Select Game Type
_description: Adds ONLINE under BATTLE MODE and QUIT under OPTIONS in the main menu (QUIT leaves the game for the host's own menu: the Dreamcast's BIOS menu, ADR-0041), and behind ONLINE an address keyboard in the look of the game's ENTER NAME screen. The menu is data: the game builds it from a list of 36-byte records, so the mod hands the builder a longer list, steers the frame handler's selection around the new line, and builds the keyboard in the same slot from records of its own. The game's own name keyboard (adventure overlay) is never touched. The rest is the PS1's own devices, each on a controller port of the mod's (ADR-0040): a Sony Mouse points and clicks, a PS/2 keyboard types the address, and DONE goes online through the i-mode adaptor — one libimode session, an HTTP request to the address on the game's port, 9457. How the menu works is in ../../notes.md, 'The main menu'.
_hooks: 0x80095bec in boot: the menu builder, (slot a0, records a1). 0x800b3ca8 in stage: Select Game Type's frame handler.
